data.exact_reserve_text: In 2017, there has been an overall deficit of GBP 4.9m on prior year reserves (2016 deficit of GBP 2.3m). The deficit is primarily driven by premium reductions and reserve increases on the marine and energy classes of business.

named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate has material exposure to the Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria ("HIM") in the 2016 and 2017 year of account. A 5% increase in Gross (Net) HIM reserves would result in an GBP 1.7m (GBP 0.1m) increase in Gross (Net) Reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2017 were GBP 110.206m. Using the reported gross claims development triangle, older underwriting years (2011-2015) show a net adverse movement of c. GBP 7.03m (gross), i.e. a strengthening of reserves of ~6.4% of opening reserves. The managing agent reports an overall net prior-year deficit of GBP 4.9m (net of reinsurance), which the report attributes primarily to premium reductions and reserve increases in the marine and energy classes.
raw_causal_phrases: overall deficit of GBP 4.9m on prior year reserves
The deficit is primarily driven by premium reductions and reserve increases on the marine and energy classes of business.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was not explicitly stated in a single 'movement in prior years' gross line. The gross prior-year movement was calculated from the published gross claims development (cumulative incurred) triangle by comparing the latest estimate for each underwriting year <=2015 with its prior diagonal (per the rules). The managing agent narrative provides only a net prior-year deficit of GBP 4.9m (net of reinsurance) - no gross PYD figure was stated. Triangle values are reported in the note in GBP '000; all primary reserve and movement figures above are reported in millions (converted).
